content: We have carbon NMR data: chemical shifts list. Need number of methyl groups (CH3). Methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm for aliphatic, also maybe 20-30. In list we have 26.40, 36.40 (two identical), 58.70, plus aromatic carbons (126-168). The methyl likely at 26.40 ppm. Also 36.40 could be methylene or tertiary carbon. 58.70 likely carbon attached to heteroatom (e.g., OCH3). OCH3 also methyl but shift ~55-60 ppm. So there could be two methyl groups: one aliphatic (26.4) and one O-methyl (58.7). Need to infer molecule. Let's also get proton NMR to confirm.
